laya.description: TypeSafe Jev / laya System-1 decision tools (choice/noul/score) served remotely from laya-serve on hydrogenium (192.168.5.2:8011) — the same endpoint pi-jev points at. Launched on demand via uv (installs the laya[mcp] PyPI package into an ephemeral env), so no pre-existing install is required.
